25hours Hotels is a design-focused boutique hotel brand that creates unique, culturally resonant hotels in vibrant cities around the world. Founded in 2005, the company started with a single property in Hamburg, Germany, and has since expanded to operate 17 hotels with 3,250 rooms in major cities such as Berlin, Paris, and Dubai. As part of Ennismore, which entered a joint venture with Accor in 2021, 25hours Hotels emphasizes individuality in each location, guided by the motto "You know one, you know none."

The hotels feature a mix of contemporary services and upscale amenities, catering to both leisure and business travelers. Each property includes multi-functional spaces, signature restaurants like NENI, and social hubs that foster connections between global travelers and local guests. The brand attracts design enthusiasts and adventurous travelers who appreciate fair prices and culturally authentic experiences, all while maintaining a focus on personal relationships and community engagement.
